statisticsPage.homesScope: Homes with payments this year: fees by accounting month and repairs by payment date. Fund contributions are included in fees. Unpaid obligations are not shown.
statisticsPage.feesScope: Paid fees by accounting month, including fund contributions. Receipt names and archived fee history are retained.
statisticsPage.billsScope: Actual bill payments by accounting month for the selected year, including archived bills.
statisticsPage.expensesScope: Other cash expenses by accounting month, plus repair and fund expenses by operation date. Paid bills are shown separately under By bills.
statisticsPage.repairsScope: Repairs with movements this year, including archived repairs. Actual payments and expenses by operation date. The result is for the period, not the overall balance.
statisticsPage.fundsScope: Funds with movements this year, including archived funds. Contributions by accounting month, expenses by operation date. The result is for the period, not the overall balance.
statisticsPage.noEntries: No recorded movements for the selected year.
statisticsPage.title: Statistics
statisticsPage.intro: Annual reports by homes, fees, bills, expenses, months, repairs and funds.
statisticsPage.noMonths: No accounting months for this year up to the current month.
statisticsPage.incomeHint: Cash receipts, including amounts allocated to funds.
statisticsPage.expensesHint: Paid bills and other cash expenses.
statisticsPage.forFundsHint: Money set aside from cash for funds.
statisticsPage.differenceHint: Income minus expenses and allocations to funds.
statisticsPage.scope: By accounting month, up to and including the current month. Open months show provisional amounts. Repair payments, repair expenses and fund expenses are excluded.

printPage.selectionHint: Choose the homes that need payment slips. Homes fully paid for this month are excluded.

printPage.noReceiptHomes: There are no homes requiring payment slips.
printPage.propertiesHint: A4 portrait · signature list and fee summary
printPage.receiptsHint: A4 landscape · 3 slips per row · Turn off double-sided printing in the printer settings.
printPage.title: Print documents
printPage.intro: Choose a building and month. The property list and payment slips are prepared together in one document.
printPage.pdfHint: Choose a printer or Save as PDF. Orientation is set for each section. Use A4, 100% scale, 5 mm margins and no browser headers or footers. All fees for the month are included, including paid fees.
printPage.error: Unable to prepare the document. Please retry.

financeOverview.title: Financial overview
financeOverview.intro: All building funds in one place
financeOverview.loadError: Unable to load finances. Check your access and try again.
financeOverview.scope: Overview of all recorded movements, including money held in archived funds and repairs.
financeOverview.monthlyHint: Includes all generated accounting months. Difference = income − funds − expenses; balance = difference + carryover.
financeOverview.recentHint: Latest {{limit}} movements by payment/recording date. Filters apply to this list. Fund fees are included only once.

cashierFinance.readyToClose: All fees and bills are paid. This month can be closed.
cashierFinance.closeRequirements: Pay all home fees and bills before closing the month.
cashierFinance.closeExplanation: Closing prevents new payments, income and expenses for this month. Payments in earlier months will continue to update the carried balance and total.
cashierFinance.notSettled: There are unpaid fees or bills. Refresh and settle them before closing.
cashierFinance.closeError: Closing could not be confirmed. You can retry.
cashierFinance.balanceFormula:
Monthly difference = income − fund allocations − expenses and bills.
Total = monthly difference + previous balance.
